title: Resolve browser presentation authority
purpose: Transform an authorized walkthrough scene plan into an ordered platform-neutral browser presentation plan.
trigger: an authorized walkthrough scene plan and presentation profile are submitted
desiredOutcome: every scene has complete browser presentation authority without embedding browser-engine mechanics
constraints: semantic scene targets remain stable across presentation surfaces
no CSS selector, XPath, DOM query, or browser SDK command is projected
every operation is ordered before execution
unsupported surfaces and targets fail closed
the resolved plan declares its proof requirements
